title: Continuity of iterated interval smoothing
statement: Let $\eta>0$, let $\psi\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be continuous, and let $m\in\mathbb N$. The result of applying the interval smoothing $S_\eta$ to $\psi$ repeatedly $m$ times is continuous on $\mathbb R$.
